units.source_text: 且说玉鬘自从踏歌会时与紫姬等见面之后，常常对诸人通讯问候。

en.t: After Tamakazura met Lady Murasaki and the others at the stamping-song festival, she often exchanged letters and greetings with them.

units.source_text: 玉鬘教养深浅如何，紫姬等未能深悉。

en.t: Lady Murasaki and the others did not yet know how deep Tamakazura's upbringing and accomplishments really were.

units.source_text: 但觉其人富有才气，而又温柔恭谨，对人一见如故。

en.t: They only felt that she was richly talented, gentle, modest, and able to make people feel as if they had known her for a long time.

units.source_text: 因此大家对她怀有好感。

en.t: Because of this, everyone felt well disposed toward her.
There were many people who longed for her in love.

units.source_text: 然而源氏认为此事不可草草决定。

en.t: Genji, however, thought that the matter must not be decided carelessly.

units.source_text: 而他自己心中，恐怕也觉得不愿长此做她的父亲，所以有时竟想通知她的真父亲内大臣，揭穿实情，以便公然娶她。

en.t: In his own heart, he probably also felt unwilling to remain her father forever, and at times he even thought of informing her real father, the Minister of the Center, revealing the truth, and then openly taking her as his wife.

units.source_text: 夕雾中将对玉鬘较为亲近，常常走近她的帘幕旁边。

en.t: Lieutenant General Yugiri was relatively close to Tamakazura and often came near the curtains around her room.
Tamakazura herself would also answer him directly.

units.source_text: 此时玉鬘总是羞人答答。

en.t: At such times, Tamakazura was always bashful and shy.

units.source_text: 夕雾则确信人人知道他们是姐弟关系，所以对她一本正经，绝不发生爱欲。

en.t: Yugiri was convinced that everyone knew they were brother and sister, so he behaved toward her with complete seriousness and never felt any desire for her.

units.source_text: 内大臣家诸公子不知道玉鬘是他们的异母妹，常假手夕雾，对她表示万般相思。

en.t: The young gentlemen of the Minister of the Center's household did not know that Tamakazura was their half sister, and they often used Yugiri as an intermediary to express all kinds of longing for her.

units.source_text: 玉鬘对他们全不动情，只是私下感到兄妹之爱，心中怀着说不出的痛苦。

en.t: Tamakazura felt no romantic attraction to them at all; she only felt a private sibling affection, while carrying an inexpressible pain in her heart.

units.source_text: 她独自思量：总得教真的父亲知道我在这里才好。

en.t: She thought to herself that somehow she ought to let her true father know that she was here.

units.source_text: 然而并不向源氏说出，只装作全心全意地依赖他，像个天真烂漫的孩子。

en.t: Yet she did not say this to Genji, and only pretended to rely on him wholeheartedly, like an innocent and carefree child.

units.source_text: 她并不酷肖母亲，然而也有几分相似，才气则比夕颜更胜。

en.t: She did not look exactly like her mother, but there was still some resemblance; in talent, she surpassed Yugao even more.
